title: Avoid window function name display allocation
description: Replace window function dispatch via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: Window function precomputation no longer builds uppercase display names before classifying supported functions
ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG, and LEAD still dispatch to compute_window_function with canonical names
Qualified window function names remain unsupported as before

notes: The window precompute path now maps supported functions to static canonical names through direct ObjectNamePart comparisons.
compute_window_function still receives the same canonical function name values.
Window OVER clause checks and window result projection behavior are unchanged.
